services.value: GCA provides industrial and municipal wastewater treatment services, including activated sludge-based treatment at its regional industrial wastewater treatment facilities and tertiary UV disinfection for municipal sewage at the Blackhawk facility. It also provides non-potable water system operations, solid waste management via a non-commercial industrial solid waste landfill operated under contract, and laboratory services through a Central Laboratory performing environmental testing (NELAP-accredited).
